purpose: Non-admission discovery catalogue of public Oasis executable demo models, deterministic scenario/model package families, vulnerability inputs and explicitly licence-gated data leads. Metadata only; never a data or model admission, commercial-use approval, source-byte acquisition, or stochastic-insurance calibration.

entries.name: OasisPiWind original demo model
entries.spatial_scope: UK toy geography; fictitious Melton Mowbray setting
entries.temporal_scope: fictional event years; model commit specific
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Runnable demo plus model_data, keys_data, OED examples, generated ORD result fixtures
entries.note: Existing FFBK benchmark pins OasisPiWind commit 94820c59f169b222d4c1a72256ff0a8f86a9e5bf and reconstructs 1000-year sample AAL/OEP/AEP from published IL SPLT/PALT/PSEPT. PiWind is a fictional demo, not observed UK hazard or a calibrated insurer model. Independent licence review for each embedded asset remains required; do not import source bytes by registry entry.

entries.name: UKWind large-scale wind performance model
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 10,000 events/100,000 simulated years and advertised 20m-location scaling test; GitHub model_data includes events.bin (40,000 B), occurrence.bin (21,435,572 B), vulnerability.bin (12,716,004 B), damage_bin_dict.bin, returnperiods.bin. External script references footprint.bin.z, footprint.idx.z, location_full.parquet on a public S3 endpoint.
entries.note: Pinned source review: OasisModels/UKWind/get_large_data.sh Git blob 3f8678c873d6eaf7dfb637aadab5597eadf103e7; GitHub file listings were accessible as metadata. A bounded public connector HTTP Range: bytes=0-31 probe on 2026-11-05 retrieved exactly 32 binary bytes each from footprint.bin.z, footprint.idx.z and location_full.parquet (content type binary/octet-stream). This is first-byte public-access evidence ONLY, not proof of complete successful downloads, content lengths, file integrity, stable object versions, SHA-256, reproducible model execution or permission to reuse/redistribute assets; direct Linux DNS and generic web reader did not support the test. Root OasisModels software BSD-3-Clause does NOT authenticate separately hosted S3 licence; no historical hazard or insurer calibration inferred.

entries.name: ParisWindstorm example

entries.note: Small single-peril example, not a calibrated pan-European event set. Root OasisModels software BSD-3-Clause; inspect local test/model assets and terms individually. Keep distinct from separately published Impact Forecasting EUWS scenario family.

entries.name: PiWind technical variants (multi-repository family)
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Official repository folders: PiWind, PiWindAbsoluteDamage, PiWindAzure, PiWindBI, PiWindComplexModel, PiWindDtype, PiWindPostLossAmplification, PiWindPostcode, PiWindPreAnalysis, PiWindS3, PiWindSinglePeril, PiWindVulnerability
entries.note: Index of 12 technical variants including main PiWind, not 12 independently calibrated natural-hazard models. AbsoluteDamage includes absolute loss amounts; Postcode illustrates disaggregation; PreAnalysis external geocoding; PostLossAmplification uplift; SinglePeril wind-only; Vulnerability adjustments, BI, data type and cloud variants require individual assessment. Root software licence BSD-3-Clause; linked assets need specific review.

entries.name: Bangladesh tropical cyclone historical catalogue Oasis models
entries.provider: UK Met Office / BUET / Catrisk Solutions / Oasis Palmtree
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Model_data and lookup/test folders in Git; BGWTCSS1 footprint.bin.z and footprint.idx.z downloaded separately using download_bgwtcss1.sh
entries.note: Repo LICENSE states MIT; that alone does not prove all separately hosted footprint scientific input or third-party data redistribution/commercial rights. Read README, download script and provider terms; pin exact files and event probability semantics before risk modelling. A 12-cyclone historical/ensemble source must not be treated as an arbitrary independent 10000-year stochastic catalogue.

Source data licence and each upstream input still require confirmation. No footprint download, byte authentication or approval undertaken here.

entries.name: Impact Forecasting EUWS deterministic windstorm scenarios
entries.temporal_scope: Two actual November 2023 windstorms: Ciarán 1-2 Nov and Domingos 4-7 Nov; 3 alternative interpolated hazard footprints for each; not a complete stochastic annual catalogue
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Model version CSV: ImpactForecasting,EUWS,1.0.0; two 12-byte event-set files; footprint.bin 4,518,908 B, vulnerability.bin 17,085,348 B; occurrence.bin 0 B; separate source_data/EUWS.zip 25,243,236 B. Footprint alternatives use 15/30/40 station neighbours.
entries.note: Source README blob dc47f484937fe5d55415868694c917c5b15ddc6b, model_settings.json blob 08f07cf6d8b52c1d0fc2c47af390ec8c6cd5fd1e. Ciarán and Domingos are two 2023 physical storm scenarios with three alternative spatial wind-field reconstructions each: NOT six independent stochastic occurrences. Source declares pan-European measured-station interpolation and includes Germany. The example analysis_settings.json selects 'ciaran', but model_settings.json declares default 'cieren' absent from option IDs 'ciaran' and 'domingos' — CONFIGURATION DEFECT CANDIDATE, verify with real model runtime before calling it an execution blocker. Empty occurrence.bin means a complete annual event probability measure is not established by this folder. Repository BSD-3-Clause text and vendor-specific footprint terms require version-by-version review; no PML/AEP/OEP or German exposure claim.

entries.name: IPE FranceHail deterministic scenario model
entries.temporal_scope: Historical storm Ela, 6-10 June 2014; six model event IDs 11-16 all assigned to period 1 of the example occurrence.csv
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Source contains 6 events and a single period in occurrence.csv; model_data includes footprint.bin.z (9,108 B), footprint.csv (40,959 B), vulnerability.bin (9,476 B), vulnerability.csv (6,340 B), occurrence.bin (80 B), and events/occurrence CSV. Source contains areaperil_dict.parquet (22,014,048 B).
entries.note: Original source metadata: model_settings.json Git blob 5f9361339f2acfd31975b32dc15c2438ee8351f9 (Ela, June 2014); events.csv blob bf415bd0437f066ee593d37503fc50bb17f19fcf (IDs 11-16); occurrence.csv blob dde40cb030a4a1de06f6cb4d3f04d5b07c709900 (all period_no=1); source_data/Read Me blob 133cc294221a4033b8b8ae215a30aaf221a9e9bb (homeowners code 102, general auto 105). Analysis settings request GUL and example AEP/OEP but IL is disabled and a one-period historical example does not establish a validated annual stochastic measure, cedant net losses or reliable return periods. Neither six IDs nor identical placeholder dates prove six independent physical events. Regional damage functions require validation before German property use; vendor source rights remain unverified despite Scenarios repository BSD-3-Clause.
